claude-code: no gateway configured; traffic is not routed through Halos
claude-code: sandbox.protectedPaths [.env*] are workspace-relative; managed sandbox.filesystem paths have no documented project root, so they are enforced on the Read/Edit tools only, not on Bash
claude-code: egress default deny: the WebFetch tool still asks before fetching a host outside the allowlist (deny rules win over allow rules, so deny-by-default cannot be expressed for it); Bash is held to the allowlist by the sandbox
claude-code: the Claude Code sandbox does not run on native Windows; sandbox and egress settings are not enforced there (use WSL2)
